_comment: Phase 4 model config, shared by CIC-IDS2017 and UNSW-NB15. Same three sklearn models and the same methodology as Phase 3 (configs/phase3_nsl_kdd.json) so the within-dataset numbers are directly comparable across all three datasets. The LSTM is intentionally NOT included for the flow datasets - see DEVELOPMENT_NOTES.md section 11.4 (flow records carry no packet-level temporal order; the NSL-KDD 'context window' framing does not transfer). Grids are searched on the VALIDATION split only; the test split is used once, at final evaluation.
_imbalance_note: class_weight='balanced' on every model. The Phase-2 SMOTE arrays (X_train_balanced.npy) are written for each dataset and remain available as the documented alternative.

svm_rbf._subsample_note: libsvm RBF is ~O(n^2-3); training is capped at a seeded stratified subsample (same as Phase 3). ROC-AUC uses decision_function.
